title: chat-server: Space/get treats principal_id None as a member of every Space
description: handle_space_get (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs ~line 401, plus non_member_non_previewable and project_space_for_caller docs) sets caller_member_id = None when JmapBackend::principal_id returns None, so the draft §Space/get non-member rules (notFound / restricted view) never apply without identity. JMAP-yt1w.33 made the Space permission and role-hierarchy gates always resolve against the owner's member entry (accountId); this read-visibility rule was left alone because it is not a permission/hierarchy gate and, until JMAP-yt1w.34 is fixed, enforcing it would hide every newly created Space from its creator. Decide whether Space/get should also key on accountId unconditionally; blocked by JMAP-yt1w.34.
notes:
Mark 2026-10-19 ('fix the still opens'): Space/get membership/visibility keys on the accountId member entry unconditionally, consistent with the .33 decision; drop the principal_id None => member-of-every-Space fallback.
Implemented (uncommitted): handle_space_get keys membership on &account_id unconditionally; helpers take &Id; fallback docs removed (space.rs, crate AGENTS.md). Existing tests that read stored members/description via Space/get after the owner left/was non-member now read via JmapBackend::get_objects; single_user_mode_sees_full_space now seeds the accountId member entry. Gates: fmt, clippy, test chat-server/testjig/chat-client, doc all pass.
Done in b8b6f251: tests owner_without_identity_non_member_private_space_is_not_found, owner_without_identity_non_member_previewable_space_is_restricted, owner_without_identity_sees_full_view_of_created_space; changed existing tests: single_user_mode_sees_full_space, space_self_removal_by_account_id_is_permitted (helper space_members), closed_space_rejects_updates_except_self_removal, owner_without_member_entry_cannot_mutate_metadata, non_member_caller_cannot_mutate_metadata, self_removal_without_manage_members_is_permitted, last_admin_self_removal_bypasses_last_admin_protection (helper member_ids)
